Introduction
This document lists the minor maintenance 
procedure P1, 
which must be performed every four years or 40.000 operation hours bases as indicated in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed El-Sabagh & eng. Adel Saad Zaghlool, 
 revised by eng. Mohamed selim & eng. Sobhy Abel Halim, accepted by general 
 manager eng. Mohamed Abd Elghaffar, and approved by Al Aresh PS Head Sector 
 eng. 
 The internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, safety shoes.
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, safety shoes.
The equipment must be fully isolated mechanically and electrically.
Isolated equipment circuit breaker, off position.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Lifting ropes, Wooden blocks.
Cleaning fluids,
Spear parts:
Work to be Carried Out
Disassembly
Disconnect the discharge & suction lines.
Remove cap head screws and nuts.
Press spring dowels.
Screw in forcing set screw to break seal between casings.
Lift top half casing off studs and clear of impeller.
Check clearance between case wear rings and impeller and compare it with data 
 sheet.
Remove bearing cap.
Remove both T.E bearing retaining nuts.
Tap bearing housing with T.E bearing.
Slide gland lantern ring.
Remove T.E case wear ring
Pull sleeve with seal off end of shaft.
Remove the packing.
Remove impeller and remove the remaining case wear ring.
Remove impeller key.
Reassembly by performing the above reverse order.
In the case of change the bearings. The bearings must be heated in oil bath at 
 temp. 80C.
Checks before Reassembly
Check clearance of impeller.
Check the condition of bearing.
Check the condition of shafts.
Check spacer.
Axial play of the rotor 0.1 0.3 mm
After Reassembly when the 
Pump Operates
Check the direction of rotation before coupled.
Check the Vibration.
Check the Pressure and quantity of discharge according to 
 characteristic.
Check the Motor Ampere.
Check the Temperature of oil.
Check the Abnormal noise.
